source: USCIS form M-1778 (09/25), 128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version), uscis.gov
note: Questions and answers verified verbatim against the official USCIS text on 2026-11-10. explain_so lines are DRAFT Somali explanations — pending the Somali quality pass before shipping in the app. 'changes' marks answers that depend on current office-holders or the learner's state (check uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates before an interview).

questions.q: What is the form of government of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku waa jamhuuriyad ay dadku doorasho ku xukuntaan.

questions.q: What is the supreme law of the land?
questions.explain_so: Dastuurka Maraykanku waa sharciga ugu sarreeya dalka.

questions.q: Name one thing the U.S. Constitution does.
answers: Protects the rights of the people
questions.explain_so: Dastuurku wuxuu dhisaa dowladda oo qeexaa awoodahaheeda.

questions.q: The U.S. Constitution starts with the words “We the People.” What does “We the People” mean?
questions.explain_so: Waxay la macno tahay dadka ayaa is xukuma.

questions.q: How are changes made to the U.S. Constitution?
questions.explain_so: Dastuurka waxaa lagu beddelaa isbeddelo la yiraahdo amendments.

questions.q: What does the Bill of Rights protect?
answers: (The basic) rights of people living in the United States
questions.explain_so: Bill of Rights wuxuu ilaaliyaa xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee dadka.

questions.q: How many amendments does the U.S. Constitution have?
questions.explain_so: Dastuurka wuxuu leeyahay toddoba iyo labaatan (27) isbeddel.

questions.q: Why is the Declaration of Independence important?
answers: It says America is free from British control.
It says all people are created equal.
questions.explain_so: Waxay muhiim tahay sababtoo ah waxay sheegtay in Maraykanku xor ka yahay Ingiriiska.

questions.q: What founding document said the American colonies were free from Britain?
questions.explain_so: Dastuurka ku dhawaaqista madaxbannaanida ayaa sheegay in mustamaraadku xor yihiin.

questions.q: Name two important ideas from the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution.
questions.explain_so: Fikradaha muhiimka ah waxaa ka mid ah sinnaanta iyo xorriyadda.

questions.q: The words “Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness” are in what founding document?
questions.explain_so: Erayadaas waxay ku qoran yihiin Dastuurka ku dhawaaqista madaxbannaanida.

questions.q: What is the economic system of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Dhaqaalaha Maraykanku waa suuq xorta ah oo ganacsi ku salaysan.

questions.q: What is the rule of law?
answers: No one is above the law.
questions.explain_so: Sharciga waa in qof walba u hoggaansamo, xitaa hoggaamiyayaasha.

questions.q: Many documents influenced the U.S. Constitution. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Dastuurka waxaa saameeyay dukumentiyo badan, sida Dastuurka ku dhawaaqista madaxbannaanida.

questions.q: There are three branches of government. Why?
answers: So one part does not become too powerful
questions.explain_so: Saddexda laamood ayaa loo qaybiyay si aan midna u xoog badnaan.

questions.q: Name the three branches of government.
questions.explain_so: Saddexda laamood waa sharci-dejinta, fulinta iyo garsoorka.

questions.q: The President of the United States is in charge of which branch of government?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu hoggaamiyaa laanta fulinta.

questions.q: What part of the federal government writes laws?
questions.explain_so: Kongarasku wuxuu qoraa sharciyada.

questions.q: What are the two parts of the U.S. Congress?
questions.explain_so: Kongarasku wuxuu ka kooban yahay Senate iyo House.

questions.q: Name one power of the U.S. Congress.
questions.explain_so: Kongarasku wuxuu qoraa sharciyo, dagaal ku dhawaaqaa, oo miisaaniyad sameeyaa.

questions.q: How many U.S. senators are there?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa jira boqol (100) senator.

questions.q: How long is a term for a U.S. senator?
questions.explain_so: Senator wuxuu shaqeeyaa lix sano.

questions.q: Who is one of your state’s U.S. senators now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents and residents of U.S. territories should answer that D.C. (or the territory where the applicant lives) has no U.S. senators.]
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu way is beddeli kartaa, waana inaad sheegto senator-ka gobolkaaga; hubi ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: How many voting members are in the House of Representatives?
questions.explain_so: House of Representatives wuxuu leeyahay afar boqol iyo shan iyo soddon (435) xubnood oo cod bixiya.

questions.q: How long is a term for a member of the House of Representatives?
questions.explain_so: Xubin House-ka wuxuu shaqeeyaa laba sano.

questions.q: Why do U.S. representatives serve shorter terms than U.S. senators?
answers: To more closely follow public opinion
questions.explain_so: Waqtiga gaaban wuxuu u oggolaanayaa inay si dhow u raacaan ra'yiga dadweynaha.

questions.q: How many senators does each state have?
questions.explain_so: Gobol kastaa wuxuu leeyahay laba senator.

questions.q: Why does each state have two senators?
questions.explain_so: Gobol walba wuxuu leeyahay laba senator si loo helo matalaad siman.

questions.q: Name your U.S. representative.
answers: Answers will vary. [Residents of territories with nonvoting Delegates or Resident Commissioners may provide the name of that Delegate or Commissioner. Also acceptable is any statement that the territory has no (voting) representatives in Congress.]
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu way is beddeli kartaa, waana inaad sheegto xubintaada House-ka; hubi ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: What is the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives.
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu way is beddeli kartaa marka Speaker cusub yimaado, sidaas darteed hubi uscis.gov ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: Who does a U.S. senator represent?
questions.explain_so: Senator wuxuu matalaa dadka gobolkiisa.

questions.q: Who elects U.S. senators?
questions.explain_so: Dadka gobolka ayaa dooranaya senator-ka.

questions.q: Who does a member of the House of Representatives represent?
questions.explain_so: Xubinta House waxay matashaa dadka deggan district-keeda.

questions.q: Who elects members of the House of Representatives?
questions.explain_so: Dadka district-ka ayaa dooranaya xubinta House-ka.

questions.q: Some states have more representatives than other states. Why?
questions.explain_so: Gobollada dadka badan waxay leeyihiin xubno badan.

questions.q: The President of the United States is elected for how many years?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynaha waxaa la dooranayaa afar sano.

questions.q: The President of the United States can serve only two terms. Why?
answers: To keep the president from becoming too powerful
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu shaqayn karaa laba xilli oo keliya si aanu u xoog badnaan.

questions.q: What is the name of the President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the President of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Magaca madaxweynaha wuu is beddeli karaa, sidaas darteed hubi uscis.gov ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: What is the name of the Vice President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Vice President of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Magaca madaxweyne ku xigeenka wuu is beddeli karaa, sidaas darteed hubi uscis.gov ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: If the president can no longer serve, who becomes president?
answers: The Vice President (of the United States)
questions.explain_so: Haddii madaxweynuhu shaqayn karin, madaxweyne ku xigeenka ayaa noqda madaxweyne.

questions.q: Name one power of the president.
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu saxeexaa sharciyo, joojiyaa sharciyo, wuxuuna hoggaamiyaa ciidamada.

questions.q: Who is Commander in Chief of the U.S. military?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu waa taliyaha guud ee ciidamada Maraykanka.

questions.q: Who signs bills to become laws?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu saxeexaa sharciyada si ay sharci u noqdaan.

questions.q: Who vetoes bills?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu joojin karaa sharci (veto).

questions.q: Who appoints federal judges?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu magacaabaa garsoorayaasha federaalka.

questions.q: The executive branch has many parts. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Laanta fulinta waxaa ka mid ah madaxweynaha iyo golaha wasiirada.

questions.q: What does the President’s Cabinet do?
answers: Advises the President (of the United States)
questions.explain_so: Golaha wasiirada waxay talo siiyaan madaxweynaha.

questions.q: What are two Cabinet-level positions?
answers: Secretary of Health and Human Services
Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency
Administrator of the Small Business Administration
Director of the Central Intelligence Agency
Director of the Office of Management and Budget
questions.explain_so: Xilalka heer wasiir waxaa ka mid ah Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud iyo wasiiro badan.

questions.q: Why is the Electoral College important?
answers: It decides who is elected president.
It provides a compromise between the popular election of the president and congressional selection.
questions.explain_so: Electoral College ayaa go'aamisa cidda madaxweyne noqonaysa.

questions.q: What is one part of the judicial branch?
questions.explain_so: Laanta garsoorka waxaa ka mid ah Maxkamadda Sare.

questions.q: What does the judicial branch do?
answers: Decides if a law goes against the (U.S.) Constitution
questions.explain_so: Laanta garsoorku waxay dib u eegtaa sharciyada oo xalliyaa khilaafaadka.

questions.q: What is the highest court in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Maxkamadda Sare waa maxkamadda ugu sarreysa Maraykanka.

questions.q: How many seats are on the Supreme Court?
questions.explain_so: Maxkamadda Sare waxay leedahay sagaal (9) kursi.

questions.q: How many Supreme Court justices are usually needed to decide a case?
questions.explain_so: Shan (5) garsoore ayaa badanaa loo baahan yahay si kiis loo go'aamiyo.

questions.q: How long do Supreme Court justices serve?
questions.explain_so: Garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Sare waxay shaqeeyaan inta ay nool yihiin.

questions.q: Supreme Court justices serve for life. Why?
questions.explain_so: Waxay shaqeeyaan inta ay nool yihiin si ay uga madaxbannaadaan siyaasadda.

questions.q: Who is the Chief Justice of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Chief Justice of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Magaca Madaxa Garsoorka wuu is beddeli karaa, sidaas darteed hubi uscis.gov ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: Name one power that is only for the federal government.
questions.explain_so: Dowladda federaalku waxay daabacdaa lacagta oo dagaal ku dhawaaqdaa.

questions.q: Name one power that is only for the states.
questions.explain_so: Gobolladu waxay bixiyaan waxbarasho iyo shatiga darawalnimada.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the 10th Amendment?
answers: (It states that the) powers not given to the federal government belong to the states or to the people.
questions.explain_so: 10th Amendment waxay sheegaysaa in awoodaha aan federaalka la siin ay leeyihiin gobollada ama dadka.

questions.q: Who is the governor of your state now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. does not have a governor.]
questions.explain_so: Guddoomiyaha gobolkaagu wuu is beddeli karaa, waana inaad magaciisa sheegto; hubi ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: What is the capital of your state?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. is not a state and does not have a capital. Residents of U.S. territories should name the capital of the territory.]
questions.explain_so: Caasimadda gobolkaagu way ku xiran tahay gobolka aad deggan tahay, sidaas darteed hubi ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: There are four amendments to the U.S. Constitution about who can vote. Describe one of them.
answers: You don’t have to pay (a poll tax) to vote.
Any citizen can vote. (Women and men can vote.)
A male citizen of any race (can vote).
questions.explain_so: Mid ka mid ah afar isbeddel oo ku saabsan cidda cod bixin karta waa in qof kasta oo 18 jir ah uu cod bixin karo.

questions.q: Who can vote in federal elections, run for federal office, and serve on a jury in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Muwaadiniinta Maraykanka oo keliya ayaa cod bixiya, u tartami kara xafiis federaal, oo ka mid noqon kara xeerbeegti.

questions.q: What are three rights of everyone living in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Qof kasta oo Maraykanka deggan wuxuu leeyahay xorriyad hadal, isu-imaatin iyo diin.

questions.q: What do we show loyalty to when we say the Pledge of Allegiance?
questions.explain_so: Marka aad tidhaahdo Pledge of Allegiance waxaad daacad u tahay Maraykanka iyo calankiisa.

questions.q: Name two promises that new citizens make in the Oath of Allegiance.
answers: Give up loyalty to other countries
Obey the laws of the United States
Serve (help, do important work for) the nation (if needed)
Be loyal to the United States
questions.explain_so: Muwaadin cusub wuxuu ballan qaadayaa inuu ilaaliyo dastuurka oo u hoggaansamo sharciyada.

questions.q: How can people become United States citizens?
answers: Be born in the United States, under the conditions set by the 14th Amendment
Derive citizenship (under conditions set by Congress)
questions.explain_so: Qof wuxuu muwaadin noqon karaa isagoo ku dhashay Maraykanka ama isagoo naturalize sameeya.

questions.q: What are two examples of civic participation in the United States?
answers: Give an elected official your opinion (on an issue)
Support or oppose an issue or policy
questions.explain_so: Ka qaybgalka bulshada waxaa ka mid ah cod bixinta iyo la xiriirka mas'uuliyiinta la doortay.

questions.q: What is one way Americans can serve their country?
answers: Work for local, state, or federal government
questions.explain_so: Waxaad dalkaaga u adeegi kartaa adigoo cod bixiya ama ciidamada ku biira.

questions.q: Why is it important to pay federal taxes?
answers: All people pay to fund the federal government
questions.explain_so: Canshuurta federaalka waa waajib sharci ah oo dowladda lagu maalgeliyo.

questions.q: It is important for all men age 18 through 25 to register for the Selective Service. Name one reason why.
answers: Makes the draft fair, if needed
questions.explain_so: Ragga 18 ilaa 25 jir ah waa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan Selective Service waana waajib sharci ah.

questions.q: The colonists came to America for many reasons. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Dadkii hore ee Yurub waxay u yimaadeen Maraykanka si ay xorriyad u helaan.

questions.q: Who lived in America before the Europeans arrived?
questions.explain_so: Ka hor Yurubta, waxaa Maraykanka degganaa Hindida Maraykanka (Native Americans).

questions.q: What group of people was taken and sold as slaves?
questions.explain_so: Dadka Afrikaanka ah ayaa la qaatay oo addoommo ahaan loo iibiyay.

questions.q: What war did the Americans fight to win independence from Britain?
questions.explain_so: Dagaalkii Kacaanka Maraykanka ayaa xornimada laga qaatay Ingiriiska.

questions.q: Name one reason why the Americans declared independence from Britain.
answers: British soldiers stayed in Americans’ houses (boarding, quartering)
questions.explain_so: Canshuurta badan iyo matalaad la'aanta ayaa sabab u ahayd madaxbannaanida.

questions.q: Who wrote the Declaration of Independence?
questions.explain_so: Thomas Jefferson ayaa qoray Dastuurka ku dhawaaqista madaxbannaanida.

questions.q: When was the Declaration of Independence adopted?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa la ansixiyay 4da Luulyo 1776.

questions.q: The American Revolution had many important events. Name one.
answers: Washington Crossing the Delaware (Battle of Trenton)
questions.explain_so: Dhacdooyinka muhiimka ah waxaa ka mid ah Dagaalkii Bunker Hill.

questions.q: There were 13 original states. Name five.
questions.explain_so: 13 gobol ayaa ahaa kuwii ugu horreeyay, sida New York iyo Virginia.

questions.q: What founding document was written in 1787?
questions.explain_so: Dastuurka Maraykanka ayaa la qoray 1787.

questions.q: The Federalist Papers supported the passage of the U.S. Constitution. Name one of the writers.
questions.explain_so: Qorayaasha Federalist Papers waxaa ka mid ahaa James Madison.

questions.q: Why were the Federalist Papers important?
answers: They helped people understand the (U.S.) Constitution.
questions.explain_so: Waxay dadka ka caawisay inay fahmaan dastuurka oo ay taageeraan.

questions.q: Benjamin Franklin is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Founded the first free public libraries
First Postmaster General of the United States
Helped write the Declaration of Independence
questions.explain_so: Benjamin Franklin wuxuu ahaa hal-abuur badan oo ka caawiyay qorista Dastuurka madaxbannaanida.

questions.q: George Washington is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: First president of the United States
questions.explain_so: George Washington wuxuu ahaa madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee Maraykanka.

questions.q: Thomas Jefferson is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Writer of the Declaration of Independence
Third president of the United States
Doubled the size of the United States (Louisiana Purchase)
Writer of the Virginia Statute on Religious Freedom
questions.explain_so: Thomas Jefferson wuxuu qoray Dastuurka madaxbannaanida oo ahaa madaxweynihii saddexaad.

questions.q: James Madison is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Fourth president of the United States
One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
questions.explain_so: James Madison waxaa loo yaqaan aabbaha dastuurka.

questions.q: Alexander Hamilton is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
Helped establish the First Bank of the United States
questions.explain_so: Alexander Hamilton wuxuu ahaa wasiirkii ugu horreeyay ee khasnadda.

questions.q: What territory did the United States buy from France in 1803?
questions.explain_so: 1803 Maraykanku wuxuu Faransiiska ka iibsaday dhulka Louisiana.

questions.q: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1800s.
questions.explain_so: Dagaallada qarnigii 1800 waxaa ka mid ahaa Dagaalkii Sokeeye.

questions.q: Name the U.S. war between the North and the South.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalkii u dhexeeyay Waqooyiga iyo Koonfurta waxaa la yiraahdaa Dagaalkii Sokeeye.

questions.q: The Civil War had many important events. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Dhacdooyinka Dagaalkii Sokeeye waxaa ka mid ah Emancipation Proclamation.

questions.q: Abraham Lincoln is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Led the United States during the Civil War
questions.explain_so: Abraham Lincoln wuxuu xoreeyay addoommada oo uu hoggaamiyay dalka Dagaalkii Sokeeye.

questions.q: What did the Emancipation Proclamation do?
answers: Freed slaves in the Confederate states
Freed slaves in most Southern states
questions.explain_so: Emancipation Proclamation waxay xoreysay addoommada.

questions.q: What U.S. war ended slavery?
questions.explain_so: Dagaalkii Sokeeye ayaa soo afjaray addoonsiga.

questions.q: What amendment says all persons born or naturalized in the United States, and subject to the jurisdiction thereof, are U.S. citizens?
questions.explain_so: 14th Amendment waxay sheegaysaa in qof kasta oo ku dhashay ama naturalize ku sameeyay Maraykanka uu yahay muwaadin.

questions.q: When did all men get the right to vote?
questions.explain_so: Ragga oo dhan waxay cod bixin karaan wixii ka dambeeyay Dagaalkii Sokeeye (15th Amendment, 1870).

questions.q: Name one leader of the women’s rights movement in the 1800s.
questions.explain_so: Waxaa ka mid ah hoggaamiyayaasha xuquuqda dumarka Susan B. Anthony.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1900s.
questions.explain_so: Qarnigii 1900 Maraykanku wuxuu galay dagaallo sida World War II.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter World War I?
answers: To support the Allied Powers (England, France, Italy, and Russia)
To oppose the Central Powers (Germany, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and Bulgaria)
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay World War I sababtoo ah Jarmalku wuxuu weeraray maraakiibta Maraykanka.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: When did all women get the right to vote?
questions.explain_so: Dumarka oo dhan waxay xaq u heleen cod bixinta 1920 (19th Amendment).

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What was the Great Depression?
answers: Longest economic recession in modern history
questions.explain_so: Great Depression waxay ahayd hoos u dhac dhaqaale oo aad u dheer.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: When did the Great Depression start?
questions.explain_so: Great Depression waxay bilaabatay 1929 markii suuqa saamiyada uu dumay.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who was president during the Great Depression and World War II?
questions.explain_so: Franklin Roosevelt ayaa madaxweyne ahaa intii lagu jiray Great Depression iyo World War II.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter World War II?
answers: To support the Allied Powers (England, France, and Russia)
To oppose the Axis Powers (Germany, Italy, and Japan)
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay World War II ka dib weerarkii Pearl Harbor.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Dwight Eisenhower is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: President at the end of (during) the Korean War
Signed the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956 (Created the Interstate System)
questions.explain_so: Eisenhower wuxuu ahaa jeneraal World War II iyo madaxweynihii 34aad.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who was the United States’ main rival during the Cold War?
questions.explain_so: Cadowga ugu weynaa Maraykanka intii Cold War wuxuu ahaa Soviet Union.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: During the Cold War, what was one main concern of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Intii Cold War, waxaa laga walaacsanaa faafitaanka communism iyo dagaal nukliyeer.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter the Korean War?
answers: To stop the spread of communism
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay Korean War si uu u joojiyo faafitaanka communism.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter the Vietnam War?
answers: To stop the spread of communism
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay Vietnam War si uu u joojiyo faafitaanka communism.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What did the civil rights movement do?
questions.explain_so: Civil rights movement waxay u halgantay in la joojiyo takooridda midabka.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Martin Luther King, Jr. is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Worked for equality for all Americans
Worked to ensure that people would “not be judged by the color of their skin, but by the content of their character”
questions.explain_so: Martin Luther King Jr. wuxuu u halgamay xuquuqda madaniga ah iyo sinnaanta dadka oo dhan.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter the Persian Gulf War?
answers: To force the Iraqi military from Kuwait
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay Persian Gulf War si uu ciidanka Ciraaq uga saaro Kuwait.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What major event happened on September 11, 2001 in the United States?
answers: Terrorists took over two planes and crashed them into the World Trade Center in New York City
Terrorists took over a plane and crashed into the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia
Terrorists took over a plane originally aimed at Washington, D.C., and crashed in a field in Pennsylvania
questions.explain_so: September 11, 2001 waxaa dhacay weerar argagixiso oo ka dhan ah Maraykanka.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one U.S. military conflict after the September 11, 2001 attacks.
questions.explain_so: Waxaa ka mid ah dagaallada ka dambeeyay 9/11 War in Afghanistan.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one American Indian tribe in the United States.
questions.explain_so: Waxaa ka mid ah qabiilooyinka Hindida Maraykanka Navajo.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one example of an American innovation.
questions.explain_so: Hal-abuur Maraykan ah waxaa ka mid ah nalalka korontada (light bulb).

questions.q: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Caasimadda Maraykanku waa Washington, D.C.

questions.q: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
answers: Liberty Island [Also acceptable are New Jersey, near New York City, and on the Hudson (River).]
questions.explain_so: Taallada xorriyadda waxay ku taallaa New York Harbor iyo Liberty Island.

questions.q: Why does the flag have 13 stripes?
answers: (Because the stripes) represent the original colonies
questions.explain_so: Calanku wuxuu leeyahay 13 xariiq sababtoo ah waxaa jiray 13 mustamaraad oo hore.

questions.q: Why does the flag have 50 stars?
answers: (Because there is) one star for each state
questions.explain_so: Calanku wuxuu leeyahay 50 xiddig, mid kasta oo matalaya gobol.

questions.q: What is the name of the national anthem?
questions.explain_so: Heesta calanka Maraykanku waa The Star-Spangled Banner.

questions.q: The Nation’s first motto was “E Pluribus Unum.” What does that mean?
questions.explain_so: E Pluribus Unum waxay la macno tahay dad badan oo mid noqday.

questions.q: What is Independence Day?
answers: A holiday to celebrate U.S. independence (from Britain)
questions.explain_so: Independence Day waa maalin lagu xuso xornimada Maraykanka ee Ingiriiska, 4ta Luulyo.

questions.q: Name three national U.S. holidays.
questions.explain_so: Ciidaha qaranka waxaa ka mid ah New Year’s Day, Independence Day iyo Thanksgiving Day.

questions.q: What is Memorial Day?
answers: A holiday to honor soldiers who died in military service
questions.explain_so: Memorial Day waa maalin lagu xuso askarta ku dhimatay adeegga ciidamada.

questions.q: What is Veterans Day?
answers: A holiday to honor people in the (U.S.) military
A holiday to honor people who have served (in the U.S. military)
questions.explain_so: Veterans Day waa maalin lagu xuso dadka ciidamada Maraykanka ka soo shaqeeyay.
